description.value: The Bakery is a family-owned community hub on Wharf Avenue in Sechelt, serving a full espresso and drink menu alongside a broad range of freshly made breakfast and lunch items, and an extensive selection of house-baked cakes, pastries, scones, and desserts. Located on the Sunshine Coast, it sits in a part of BC popular with touring cyclists doing the coast route. The cafe describes itself as a welcoming gathering place for locals and visitors alike.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at lovethebakery.com is live and richly detailed, confirming an active bakery/cafe at 5500 Wharf Ave, Sechelt, BC, with phone 604-885-9729. The menu page explicitly tags items as Vegan, Vegetarian, and Gluten-free, and lists dedicated GF and vegan products. Bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, and other cyclist-specific amenities are not mentioned anywhere on the website or in the OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone number; both were sourced from the website only.
Community field is 'Unknown / Vancouver Island & Gulf Islands' but Sechelt is on the BC Sunshine Coast (not Vancouver Island or the Gulf Islands) — may affect directory categorization.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, clearly open community cafe and bakery in Sechelt with a full menu and confirmed contact details — a useful stop for touring cyclists on the Sunshine Coast.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page explicitly tags items with Vegan, Vegetarian, Gluten, and Dairy filters; dedicated sections include 'Vegan & Healthy Options' (Chia Bites, Vegan Breakfast Cookies, Harvest Granola), 'Avocado Vegan Chocolate Cake', 'GF Chocolate Cake', and 'Gluten Free Sandwich'
